description: A rule or an acceptance criterion that the change must meet.

source.description: Where the rule comes from, for example ticket.md#AC2 or a question ID.

verdict.description: ok when the observed behaviour meets the rule. wrong when the observed behaviour contradicts the rule. Omit it when the rule remains unverified.

saw.description: The specific product behaviour that the test session observed for this rule. Required for ok and wrong in a recorder reply.
